Name: Asked vs told
Inputs (signals): S12/S13 on a payer call → office call(s) for the same case within 14 days
Logic: Flag if any payer requirement is not mentioned on the office call, or the office call names fewer documents ('just the notes'). Confirmed when S15/S18 follow.
Output / insight: Mismatch alert before submission; days of rework added; rate by payer and team

Name: Practice friction score
Inputs (signals): S01–S07, S09, S10 on calls with the same office (practice ID / phone number)
Logic: Weighted count per practice over 30 days (see 'Score examples'): incomplete-form items, callbacks, staff unavailable, voicemail, days waiting. Top practices ranked.
Output / insight: Top contributors to enrollment delay → Field Access targeted education
Data needed: Practice ID or office phone in call details

Name: Abandonment risk score
Inputs (signals): S23–S29 across all calls for the same patient; S30 lowers the score
Logic: Running score per call: cost +2, hardship +1, logistics +2, hesitation +3, declined next step +2, application incomplete +1, failed outreach +3, support offer −2. Band: ≥6 high, 3–5 watch.
Output / insight: Rising risk alert with the calls behind it; aggregate drop-off rate by signal pattern; which offers lower risk
Data needed: Case ID; PA approval date from CRM (Phase 2) for 'approved but not started'

Name: Call close and time to decision
Inputs (signals): S19–S22 on PA requirement calls + PA milestones (CRM / payer data)
Logic: Classify each requirements call: recap + date (S19 & S20) vs generic (S22). Compare average days from requirements call to PA decision.
Output / insight: Process finding: calls ending with recap + date reach a decision ~10 days sooner (demo data)

Name: Emerging payer requirement
Inputs (signals): S13 'step therapy' / new criteria mentions by payer over weeks
Logic: Count per payer per week; flag when well above that payer's recent level.
Data needed: Payer name in transcript or call details

Name: Promise kept
Inputs (signals): S08 / S21 promise with a date → any later contact on the same case
Logic: Kept if a matching contact happens by the date; otherwise 'missed promise'.
